milestones.title: Repository Secret
milestones.when: verify: the fork has an Actions secret named `DEMO_API_KEY` (checked in Forgejo every few seconds; Forgejo sends no event)

milestones.title: Masking Is Not Protection
milestones.joke: The log hid it. The job still knew it.
milestones.when: forgejo: the second push to your fork's main (the workflow that prints the secret again; a later push also counts)

milestones.title: Cleaned Up After
milestones.when: verify: `DEMO_API_KEY` is gone again after the workflow ran twice (removed in Forgejo; checked every few seconds)
